cohort: The study included 122 Chinese pregnant women with mechanical heart valves (MHVs) who had 151 pregnancies and received warfarin throughout pregnancy, compared with 302 paired pregnancies without warfarin treatment.
finding: Chinese pregnant women with MHVs taking warfarin throughout pregnancy experienced a significantly higher pregnancy loss rate (37.1%) compared to those without warfarin (4.6%), resulting in only around a 60% chance of giving birth to a live baby without maternal complications.
